blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Quezon City government has revoked a memorandum circular it previously issued on heat-related class suspensions to “align” its policies with the Department of Education’s (DepEd) directive. Under Memorandum Circular No. 3, Series of 2025, classes in public Child Development Centers, kindergarten and Grades 1 to 12 would shift to limited face-to-face or other alternative learning modes when the heat index reached 40°C or 41°C. When the heat index reached 42°C or higher, all in-person classes would be suspended in favor of alternative learning modes.
